parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query. Details:

If the DefenseType setting is a value other than ng_account (which means you are querying website protection settings other than account security rules), you must specify this parameter.
    > You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html to query all domain names that are added to WAF.

If the DefenseType setting is ng_account (which means you are querying account security rules), do not specify this parameter. Otherwise, an error message is returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名。具体说明如下：

DefenseType取值为ng_account以外的值（即查询除账户安全规则配置以外的其他网站防护配置）时，必须设置该参数。
    > 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255880.html查询所有已添加到WAF防护的域名。

DefenseType取值是ng_account（即查询账户安全规则配置）时，不要设置该参数，否则会返回错误信息

parameters.help_en:
The type of the protection feature configuration to query. Valid values:

waf-codec: queries the decoding settings of the rule DPI engine.

tamperproof: queries the website tamper-proofing rule configurations.

dlp: queries the sensitive information leakage prevention rule configurations.

ng_account: queries the account security rule configurations.

bot_crawler: queries the allowed crawler rule configurations.

bot_intelligence: queries the bot threat intelligence rule configurations.

antifraud: queries the data risk control protection request configurations.

antifraud_js: queries the data risk control JavaScript insertion page configurations.

bot_algorithm: queries the intelligent algorithm rule configurations.

bot_wxbb_pkg: queries the version protection rules for app protection.

bot_wxbb: queries the path protection rules for app protection.

ac_blacklist: queries the IP blacklist rule configurations.

ac_highfreq: queries the automatic IP address blocking rule configurations for high-frequency web attacks.

ac_dirscan: queries the folder scan protection rule configurations.

ac_custom: queries the custom protection policy rule configurations.

whitelist: queries the whitelist rule configurations

tamperproof：表示查询网站防篡改规则配置。

dlp：表示查询防敏感信息泄漏规则配置。

ng_account：表示查询账户安全规则配置。

bot_crawler：表示查询合法爬虫规则配置。

bot_intelligence：表示查询爬虫威胁情报规则配置。

antifraud：表示查询数据风控防护请求配置。

antifraud_js：表示查询数据风控JS插入页面配置。

bot_algorithm：表示查询智能算法规则配置。

bot_wxbb_pkg：表示查询App防护的版本防护规则。

bot_wxbb：表示查询App防护的路径防护规则。

ac_blacklist：表示查询IP黑名单规则配置。

ac_highfreq：表示查询高频Web攻击IP自动封禁规则配置。

ac_dirscan：表示查询目录扫描防护规则配置。

whitelist：表示查询白名单规则配置
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
The settings for the filtering and sorting of rules, expressed as a JSON format string. The JSON string contains the following parameters:

This parameter must use the Base64 encoding format. Construct a JSON format string based on the following parameter description and then transform it into the Base64 encoding format.

filter: JSON format string | Optional | The filter conditions, described as a JSON string format that contains the following parameters:

    - nameId: String | Optional | Queries rules whose rule ID is equal to this value or whose rule name contains this value.

    - scene: String | Optional | The settings for the protection module to query. The valid values are the same as those of the DefenseType parameter.

    - enabled: Boolean | Optional | The settings for the rule status to query. Valid values:
         - false: disabled.

        - true: enabled.

    - status: Integer | Optional | The settings for the rule status to query. This parameter has the same meaning as the enabled parameter. Valid values:

        - 0: disabled.

        - 1: enabled.

    - ruleId: Integer | Optional | The settings for the rule ID to query.

    - ruleIdList: Array | Optional | The settings for the list of rule IDs to query. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

    - sceneList: Array | Optional | The settings for the list of protection modules to query. The valid values are the same as those of the DefenseType parameter. Separate multiple protection modules with commas (,).

    - originList: Array | Optional | The settings for the rule sources. Valid values: system (automatically generated by the system) and custom (manually created). Separate multiple sources with commas (,).

    - tag: String | Optional | If the settings for the protection module to query is the Protection whitelist (whitelist), you can use this parameter to query whitelist rules that skip detection for a specified module. For the valid values and meanings of the tag parameter, see the description of whitelist rule configurations in the response parameters.

    - origin: String | Optional | If the settings for the protection module to query is the Protection whitelist (whitelist), you can use this parameter to query whitelist rules automatically added by the WAF intelligent rule hosting feature. Set the value to ai. If you do not set this parameter, all whitelist rules are queried, including manually added rules and rules automatically added by the intelligent rule hosting feature.

    - category: String | Optional | If the settings for the protection module to query is the Protection whitelist (whitelist), you can use this parameter to query a specified whitelist categorization. Valid values:

        - waf: website whitelist.

        - ws: web intrusion prevention whitelist.

        - ac: access control or throttling whitelist.

        - ds: data security whitelist.

orderBy: String | Optional | The sorting field. Valid values:

    - action: the action of the rule. This value is valid only when you query custom protection policy rules.

    - gmt_modified: the last modification time. This is the default value.

    - name: the rule name.

    - status: the rule status.

desc: Boolean | Optional | Specifies whether to sort the rules in descending order. Valid values:

    - false: sorts the rules in ascending order.

    - true: sorts the rules in descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
设置规则的过滤和排序，以JSON格式字符串表达，具体包含以下参数：

该参数必须使用Base64编码格式，请按照以下参数说明构造JSON格式字符串后将其转换为Base64编码格式。

filter：JSON格式字符串 | 可选 | 过滤条件。以JSON字符串格式描述，具体包含以下参数：

    - nameId：String类型 | 可选 | 查询规则ID等于该参数值或规则名称中包含该参数值的规则。

    - scene：String类型 | 可选 | 设置要查询的防护模块，取值与DefenseType参数相同。

    - enabled：Boolean类型 | 可选 | 设置要查询的规则状态，取值：

         - false：表示已禁用。

        - true：表示已启用。

    - status：Integer类型 | 可选 | 设置要查询的规则状态，与enabled参数含义相同，取值：

        - 0：表示已禁用。

        - 1：表示已启用。

    - ruleId：Integer类型 | 可选 | 设置要查询的规则ID。

    - ruleIdList：Array类型 | 可选 | 设置要查询的规则ID列表，多个规则ID间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

    - sceneList：Array类型 | 可选 | 设置要查询的防护模块列表，取值与DefenseType参数相同，多个防护模块间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

    - originList：Array类型 | 可选 | 设置规则来源，取值为system（表示系统自动生成）和custom（表示自定义创建），设置多个规则来源时用半角逗号（,）分隔。

    - tag：String类型 | 可选 | 当设置的查询防护模块为白名单（whitelist）时，可通过设置该参数查询不检测指定模块的白名单规则。tag参数的取值和含义可参考返回参数中白名单规则配置中的描述。

    - origin：String类型 | 可选 | 当设置的查询防护模块为白名单（whitelist）时，可通过设置该参数查询WAF智能规则托管功能自动添加的白名单规则。取值固定为ai。不设置该参数表示查询所有白名单规则（包括您手动添加的规则和智能规则托管功能自动添加的规则）。

    - category：String类型 | 可选 | 当设置的查询防护模块为白名单（whitelist）时，可通过设置该参数查询指定白名单分类，取值：

        - waf：表示网站白名单。

        - ws：表示Web入侵防护白名单。

        - ac：表示访问控制/限流白名单。

        - ds：表示数据安全白名单。

orderBy：String类型 | 可选 | 排序字段，取值：

    - action：表示规则处置动作，该参数值仅在查询自定义防护策略规则时有效。

    - gmt_modified（默认）：表示最后一次修改时间。

    - name：表示规则名称。

    - status：表示规则状态。

desc：Boolean类型 | 可选 | 是否倒序排列，取值：

    - false：表示正序排列。

    - true（默认）：表示倒序排列
